title: fix(cli): gen audio help example uses a voice the default model rejects
author: lotxo1

gist.summary: Corrected `polli gen audio --help`: the example without `--model` now uses `--voice nova`, which the default `openai/tts-1` model accepts, instead of `callum`, which returned a 400. A separate example pairs `--voice callum` with `--model elevenlabs`. Added a regression test requiring help examples that set a voice without a model to use a voice accepted by `openai/tts-1`.
